purpose: Machine-readable P0 contract for table-model property enforcement. Every operator family names its required and provided property, the selected enforcer, and either an executable scan-parallel path or the reason it remains prohibited.

operators.required: Single output; branch-local scan has no ordering requirement
operators.provided: Single direct source (or Arbitrary siblings before output convergence)
operators.enforcer: none when directly satisfied; CollectNode when sibling branches must converge

operators.required: Single output; branch-local FilterNode has no ordering requirement
operators.provided: Single direct source (or Arbitrary sibling scan branches)
operators.enforcer: none for FilterNode; CollectNode only at an enclosing Single consumer

operators.sql: SELECT s1 + 1 AS projected_s1 FROM testdb.table1
operators.required: Single output; computed projection cannot be copied to each scan branch
operators.provided: Arbitrary source, but ProjectNode is not copied to every branch
operators.forbidden_parallelism_reason: Computed ProjectNode has no branch-copying or collecting property rule; the safe P0 fallback keeps the source serial.

operators.sql: SELECT * FROM testdb.table1 ORDER BY time
operators.provided: Arbitrary and unordered when sibling scans must converge
operators.forbidden_parallelism_reason: A global ORDER BY must preserve one complete ordered stream; this static path does not split an ordered scan.

operators.sql: SELECT * FROM testdb.table1 ORDER BY time LIMIT 10
operators.required: Single + Ordered(time) at the global result
operators.provided: TopKNode owns global convergence; its children are not pre-collected
operators.forbidden_parallelism_reason: The global ordering and limit are correctness-sensitive; no complete parallel global Top-K contract is claimed in P0.

operators.sql: SELECT count(s1) OVER (ORDER BY time) FROM testdb.table1
operators.provided: Unordered source unless the physical child already carries the requested order
operators.forbidden_parallelism_reason: An ordered window is order-sensitive; P0 must not split its scan without a reviewed window repartition contract.

operators.sql: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY time) FROM testdb.table1
operators.provided: Unordered source unless the physical child already carries the requested order
operators.forbidden_parallelism_reason: Row numbering over an order is globally position-sensitive; P0 must preserve one logical ordered stream.

assertions: node instanceof RowNumberNode || node instanceof WindowNode

operators.sql: SELECT s1, count(*) FROM testdb.table1 GROUP BY s1
operators.forbidden_parallelism_reason: Only direct GROUP BY scans with enable_table_group_by_hash_repartition=true have the reviewed 1xP/NxP topology; scalar, computed, streamable, ordered, distinct, mask, and general aggregation shapes retain their serial/Collect fallback.

operators.sql: SELECT * FROM testdb.table1 t1 JOIN testdb.table2 t2 ON t1.time = t2.time
operators.provided: Ordered merge-join inputs; no two-sided executable Partitioned(joinKeys) consumer
operators.forbidden_parallelism_reason: The GROUP BY-only hash sink is not a 2xP join implementation; join needs independently routed inputs and a reviewed per-bucket join operator.

operators.sql: SELECT s1 FROM testdb.table1 UNION ALL SELECT s1 FROM testdb.table1
operators.forbidden_parallelism_reason: The current static planner has no explicit branch-consuming property rule for UNION ALL, so it retains the safe source-serialization fallback.
